purpose: Skeleton-first proportion target definition. The anatomical skeleton is the source of truth; current r95 mesh proportions are diagnostic only.
rules: Do not move a corroborated joint centre merely to keep it inside the r95 mesh.
Do not use a single population mean as a hard anatomical target.
Separate skeletal targets from soft-tissue/surface targets.
Use current a003 measurements only as a comparison baseline.
Production mesh, weights and runtime rig remain unchanged until the canonical skeleton is frozen.

HJC.reason: Independent ANSUR trochanterion minus radiographic 8 mm relation agrees within 2.2 mm.

KJC.reason: ISB epicondylar centre height agrees with ANSUR lateral femoral epicondyle within 4.1 mm.

GH.reason: Current fitted depth agrees with Arm26 and stature-scaled Rajagopal reference; absolute shoulder height remains subject to whole-skeleton proportion review.

EJC_upper_arm_chain.reason: Upper-arm surface chain agrees within 3.7 mm / less than one residual SD.

distal_upper_limb.interpretation: The existing surface is genuinely short distally. Radius/ulna, wrist, metacarpals and phalanges must be re-targeted from anatomical/bony references, then the mesh lengthened around them.

foot.interpretation: The existing foot surface is unusually long. Do not scale bones blindly to 279.9 mm; first establish hindfoot/midfoot/forefoot skeletal ratios, then fit soft tissue around the validated chain.

crotch_height.note: Surface/groin shape; does not override independently corroborated HJC.

axilla_height.note: Soft-tissue/torso shape; not a bone landmark.

suprasternale_height.note: Useful torso-proportion diagnostic; skeleton placement must be checked with vertebral/sternal anatomy separately.

bideltoid_breadth.note: May reflect muscularity/soft tissue and is not a direct clavicle or scapular target.
